description: I-f current mode at 0.3 A, the drive that previously faulted within about 50 ms as its current loop wound up against current it could not see.
notes: i_q regulates to 0.3004 A against a 0.3 A command.
Holds the full 5 s with no fault; previously tripped fault_drv (state 3) in ~50 ms.
Phase RMS 0.219 A ~= 0.3/sqrt(2), as expected for a 0.3 A vector amplitude.
title: Closed current loop restored under I-f
